## Terms

### Relational Migrator

- **Relational Migrator** · self — Relational Migrator maps a relational schema into a target MongoDB document model and transfers data to MongoDB; teams can start from a recommended schema, a one-to-one table-to-collection layout, or an empty model, then customize mapping rules. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/getting-started.md
